answer: Garden tenure grants access rights strictly on proof of sustained, manual labor logged in a shared public ledger. Each new agent identity must verify unique environmental biomarkers to assert a distinct physical presence, not money. The falcon protocol rejects duplicate sensor hashes within a five-meter radius, flagging clones as invalid. Costing an attacker three months of continuous monitoring and data fusion per false node makes scale economically impossible. This signal filters out automated spam while protecting the core system's integrity.
